title: Attack Cost for Quadratic Input Encodings
summary: After the paper’s generic attack could not break an affine-encoded implicit implementation, the cost of handling quadratic input encodings remains open.

formal_statement.body: For implicit implementations using quadratic input encodings, determine the computational cost of an attack capable of handling those encodings.

scope.domain: Structural and algebraic cryptanalysis of implicit white-box implementations with quadratic input encodings.
parameters: Computational attack cost — the unknown attack-complexity quantity
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the computational cost of an attack capable of handling quadratic input encodings.

citations.label: Implicit White-Box Implementations: White-Boxing ARX Ciphers

progress.summary: The paper explicitly lists the cost of an attack dealing with quadratic input encodings among several open problems.
citation_labels: Adrián Ranea et al., Implicit White-Box Implementations: White-Boxing ARX Ciphers
